# Acknowledged generations of German rows that the tripwire (cytir/ops/german_parts_tripwire.py) reads
# below 50 %, each bound to ONE MEASURED generation (never a family). One line:
#   <generation key> ; rows=<estimated rows measured> ; share=<half-integer share measured>  # <reason>
# Key = pool|source_type|provenance|prov_id|chunk epoch|build_id|last_seen month  (pool = a domain with
# >= 1,000 German rows, or "(tail)"; last_seen month "-" = the payload has no last_seen). No consent field
# is in the key: the consent backfill restamps those (2026-10-07 false GREW alarm; see the tripwire docstring).
# Measured: task-710-artifacts/guard2-baseline-report-v2.json (twin aw_e8, 2026-10-07 06:50Z, new key;
# 69 alarmed generations, ~6.93M rows; Wikipedia DE 3,854,804 and openlegaldata 2,074,499 rows equal the
# exact census counts of task 710 section 1).
# Rules (judge() in the tripwire): an alarm matching NO line is NEW. A line acknowledges its generation only
# while the generation stays within `rows` + 20 %: a new pack the drain writes into it (a CC-w7 pack next
# week) GROWS it. Growth whose own share (from `rows` and `share` here) reads below 50 % alarms; growth that
# reads at or above it is GREW WITH PARTS (state result=warn): re-measure the line's rows and share (task 732).
# Keep `share` on every line: without it growth always alarms. A line that matches nothing is STALE (state result=warn): delete it after the
# rebuild (task 710 rebuild item 2); the list shrinks until it is empty.
# RE-MEASURE (task 742): a line may carry `; remeasured=<YYYY-MM-DD>:<tracked tripwire report path>` after
# `share`. Its rows and share then equal that report's values for this exact key (a test pins it), and the
# 710 baseline must still hold the key: a re-measure updates a line, it never adds a generation.
# EXCEPTION (task 867): a pool that crossed 1,000 German rows AFTER the baseline (a CC-w7 tranche-13 domain) has
# no baseline key; its line then carries `remeasured` too, and the named tracked report is its only measurement. Lines
# without `remeasured` are pinned to the 710 baseline sum.
#
# Sorted by rows, largest first.
